scripts.concat: printf '// GENERATED FILE — edit the fragments in js/ instead, then run `npm run concat`.\n' > script.js && cat js/01-envelope.js js/02-audio.js js/03-lottie.js js/04-petals.js js/05-polaroid.js js/06-reasons.js js/07-reveals.js js/08-quiz.js js/09-finale.js js/10-carousels.js >> script.js
